boundary.note: This provider is a pinned child process, not an HTTP service. The pact shape is kept so every boundary in the repo reads the same way, with one honest substitution: `request` is the argv plus the explicit environment handed to an injected ProcessRunner, and `response.status` is the process exit code with the stdout document as the body.
boundary.executedBy: test/contract.test.ts, against contracts/create-db-cli-boundary.contract.json, which carries the same interactions in the runner's own vocabulary and is the machine-readable half

metadata.redaction: The pinned CLI prints a `connectionString` and a `claimUrl`. Neither appears in this document. The connection string is parsed and deposited into SecretCustodyPort inside one function scope and travels onward only as the `hobo-secret://…` locator shown below; the claim URL is bearer authority for the transfer ceremony, so only its required host is recorded. The sanitized stdout fixtures under test/fixtures/ are what the tests actually feed the parser.

invariants.noShell: argv is an array handed to an injected ProcessRunner; no shell is ever spawned
invariants.noAmbientEnvironment: the child receives exactly CI, NO_COLOR, and FORCE_COLOR
invariants.noLatestSpecifier: the specifier names an exact reviewed version; `create-db@latest` would hand credential minting to an unreviewed program chosen at run time
invariants.oneRunPerKey: at most one spawn per idempotency key, because there is no read-by-id API to find a duplicate anonymous project with

request.note: Run without --region the pinned CLI geolocates the calling host and picks a region for you, which is not a placement anyone chose. The flag and its value are one argv element so no shell quoting question can arise.

request.note: The pinned CLI accepts 30m or 1h-24h. A shorter TTL is the only blast-radius control available on an anonymous database.
